name: Shrimp Gnocchi in Spicy Tomato Sauce (Fra Diavolo) with Arugula Salad

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lemon
2 red chili peppers
1 (5 oz) pkg baby arugula
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp honey
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
While the water heats up, peel and mince shallots and garlic. Place both in a small bowl.

Quarter chili peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl with the shallot and garlic. Set aside. (Be careful with chilis; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Once the water in the pot is boiling, add gnocchi and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi begins to float to the surface, about 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (16 oz) pkgs potato gnocchi
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot, garlic, chili pepper, shrimp, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are just cooked through, about 2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes to the skillet, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened slightly, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the skillet, along with the drained gnocchi, and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add half to the bowl with the dressing, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for serving.)
To serve, divide shrimp gnocchi and salad between plates or bowls. Sprinkle gnocchi with crushed red pepper and reserved Parmesan. Enjoy!
